title: Research agenda update — R33 Hubble design pattern + R35 LOB concept
rationale: Append the research agenda update for tonight's findings to MEMORY.md, including the two R33 amendments from Hubble and the R35 latent regime concept from the LOB paper.
content:
## Research Agenda Update (2026-04-26)

- **Round 29 LLM Filter** — QUEUED. No new amendments. Final design: factor residualize → SPONGEsym → SAE cluster → cointegration top-100 → 3-agent anonymized 6-category LLM top-20 → fixed ±2σ. Goal-blind prompts mandatory.

- **Round 28 Phase 2** — LLM EarningsQualityAgent (QUEUED, pending auth fix). Last design state: SubjECTive-QA 6-dimension scoring + Eva-4B evasion classifier + goal-blind prompts + VIX > 25 kill switch.

- **Round 31b** — QUEUED: Speaker-weighted FinBERT + press release FinBERT + SubjECTive-QA fusion. No new amendments.

- **Round 33** — QuantaAlpha (primary) + AlphaPROBE (secondary) + AlphaSAGE (quaternary).
  - **NEW AMENDMENT (2026-04-26)**: Bias generation toward RANGE and VOLATILITY formula families as primary positive RAG seed. De-emphasize TREND/MOMENTUM families — Hubble OOS 2025-2026 confirms trend factors decay fastest on US equities. Source: arXiv:2604.09601.
  - **NEW AMENDMENT (2026-04-26)**: Implement dual-channel RAG: positive channel = high-IC range/vol factor examples; negative channel = Epistemic Autopsy failure records (arXiv:2604.11477). Both retrieved per generation call.
  - **NEW AMENDMENT (2026-04-26)**: After diversity filter, apply family-aware selection: ensure range, volatility, reversal, volume families each have ≥1 representative in final pool. Prevents vol-family crowding. Source: arXiv:2604.09601.

- **Round 34** (concept) — Institutional ownership PEAD amplifier — unchanged.

- **Round 35** (concept) — MRP diagnostic + Wasserstein HMM + EF clustering + RMT gap.
  - **NEW CONCEPT LAYER (2026-04-26)**: Latent build-up regime detection (arXiv:2604.20949) — detect BEFORE stress onset using depth erosion + HMM entropy. Direct implementation requires LOB level-2 data (not available via yfinance). Defer until data feed upgrade. Proxy experiment: track HMM state posterior entropy rise + High-Low/Close spread expansion as daily approximations.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/prakulhiremath/LOB-Latent-Regimes (public code, worth bookmarking)

- **Round 36** (concept) — DeltaLag adaptive lead-lag pairs — unchanged.
